name: Ultra Brain Official UI System Contract
preconditions: Theme and visual world payload conform to ultra-brain.ui/v1 and interface 1.0.
The target exists in the UI registry and its compatibility status is active.
Applicable overrides and locks are resolved before preview.
obligations: Every change is validated and previewed before save or forwarding.

Theme Packages resolve world-specific concept-art atmosphere, layout language, texture, lighting, shadow, typography, component treatment, and motion together; detail controls may adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, lighting, shadow, glow, texture, blur, and transparency without replacing the selected world's illustration style.
Feature, module, project, and OS Ecosystem overrides survive compatible global changes through the hierarchy propagation payload.
Locks have priority over all overrides and global profiles.
OS Ecosystem, Living OS, and Universal Learning Engine retain repository and runtime ownership.
A successful save records the previous validated preference as a rollback point.
UI Builder saves create a revision, preserve the approved concept-art world asset, and validate component states, responsive preview and asset ownership before apply.
Rollback creates a new rollback revision; emergency restore can select only the last validated manual or applied revision.
Beginner-facing creator actions use Korean-first wording, while advanced and expert toolboxes may expose professional UI vocabulary.
World Theme selection resolves the selected concept-art asset, atmosphere, composition and component treatment as one package; hover effects remain scoped to their component.
failure_semantics: Unknown fields, unsafe values, incompatible versions, and missing registry identity fail closed.
Invalid preferences fall back to ultra-brain-official.
A downstream failure retains the prior target theme and reports the affected scope.
